raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly inferred the nationality of director André Forcier as "French" based solely on the description of the film "Coteau Rouge" as a "French-Canadian" production. The term "French-Canadian" refers to the cultural or linguistic origin of the film (produced in Quebec, Canada, by French-speaking people), not the nationality of the director. André Forcier is actually Canadian. Consequently, the Planner drew the wrong conclusion that the directors have different nationalities (French vs. Canadian) when in reality both directors are Canadian.
